offers.title: Hi there! My name is John Pe...
offers.description: Hi there! My name is John Perkins. I am in jail right now, for hacking Info Booths. He, he, he. They didn't take my neural interface away. Guess what I am doing, right now! He, he, he. Listen, I have something to tell you. You know this... HACKER EJECTED. PARDON THE INCONVENIENCE. STANDBY FOR MISSION: We represent the Socio-Anthropological Society, and need some help.  Rumors say that Malcom Thompon is helping mutants building a hive.  We do not know where he/she is at the moment, please track him/her down, and with the utmost care, approach this character, observe it and tell us what happens!

offers.description: Thank you for choosing this terminal. My success depends on your success: We need your help. The Radar Display found at Omni-1 Trade in the area of Trade District, at 337.8, 529.0, has been disabled by opposing troops... mutant riff-raff or whatever... I need not stress the tactical importance of Radar Displays, do I? Anyway, after a thorough search, we have found that the Sub-Atomic Memory Storage component needs replacement after you have secured the area. Your mission objective would then be to install the Sub-Atomic Memory Storage correctly in the Radar Display, and get out within 48 hours. Reward: 2026 XP and 1222 credits. Good luck, Shade.
